text:
priya: Heads-up — I want to change how we provision GPU nodepools + cluster-autoscaler profiles across AZs. Posting proposed Terraform + Helm snippets for review. Goal: reduce cross-AZ pod evictions during scale-down, prefer spot/spot-fallback, and tighten cost controls.

kevin: High level: are we switching from spread->binpack or adding affinity rules?

priya: Mainly adding AZ affinity on the GPU nodepool (soft preference) and tweaking CA profiles per-region. Summary:
- add `topologySpreadConstraints` for model pods to avoid eviction across AZs during scale-in
- CA: stronger scale-down delay for GPU pools (`scaleDownDelay` higher) and smaller scale-down util threshold
- terraform: expose `zoneAffinity = "soft"` var and `spotFallback=true`
- helm: set `autoscaler.profile: gpu` and per-profile overrides (see snippet)

alex: Two quick concerns: 1) AZ imbalance -> long provisioning in the underutilized AZ and 2) GPU driver rollout race during new node creation. We should ensure the GPU DaemonSet tolerates taints while drivers install.

jamie: Agree w/ alex. Also we should run a staging canary with 10% of GPU capacity in a single AZ to validate scale-down behavior. Add a metric for unexpected evictions (prometheus rule).

priya: Good call. Here's the helm values snippet I want to use for the autoscaler chart (short):
```
autoscaler:
  enabled: true
  profile: gpu
  profiles:
    gpu:
      maxTotalUnreadyPercentage: 45
      scaleDownUtilizationThreshold: 0.15
      scaleDownDelay: 15m
      expander: least-waste
      balanceSimilarNodeGroups: true
```

kevin: Looks sensible. For TF, add these vars to the module: `zone_affinity`, `spot_fallback`, `grace_period_seconds` for node termination. Example: 
```hcl
module "gpu_nodepool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@infra.git//modules/gke-nodepool"
  name   = "gpu-pool"
  machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g"
  min_size = 1
  max_size = 40
  zone_affinity = "soft" # soft|strict|none
  spot_fallback = true
}
```

infra-bot: Plan queued: terraform plan started for module/gpu_nodepool (PR #1427) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: If `zone_affinity=soft` we still need cross-AZ quotas per-nodepool. Consider `max_nodes_per_zone = ceil(max_size / 2)` for 3 AZs. Prevents blowout in one AZ.

priya: I'll add `max_nodes_per_zone` to the module and default to `ceil(var.max_size / var.az_count) + 2` so we keep a buffer. Also will wire a `scale_down_protected_pods` list for critical jobs.

jamie: For driver issues: ensure `nvidia-device-plugin` DaemonSet has: `tolerations: - key: node.kubernetes.io/not-ready` and `podPriority` high so it gets scheduled early. Add readinessProbe to node exporter for GPU readiness.

kevin: Also add kubelet flags: `--eviction-hard=imagefs.available<5%` and `--eviction-soft` to help preserve GPU pods. If a node is under memory pressure we don't want to kill long-running model pods without graceful drain.

priya: Rollout plan:
1) Create new GPU nodepool module version with new vars and defaults (staging only).
2) Deploy helm autoscaler profile to staging with `scaleDownDelay=30m` and run canary jobs.
3) Validate metrics for 48h (evictions, pending scheduling time, provisioning time by AZ).
4) If ok, cherry-pick to prod with 10% canary pool, monitor 24h, then full roll.

alex: Make sure the migration includes a `cordon+drain` helper (script in repo) to move existing pods off-old-pools before deleting nodes.

priya: Will add the script and a checklist. Also creating two alerts: `HighGPUEvictions` and `AZImbalanceRatio>2.0`.

jamie: One more: cost tradeoff doc snippet — prefer spot with `spot_fallback` but cap `max_price_pct=60` of on-demand. If spot premiums spike, fallback to on-demand.

priya: Noted. I'll add `max_spot_price_pct` to the tf module.

kevin: LGTM from infra. If you push the PR, please include the helm values test matrix and the `terraform plan` output screenshot in the PR description. :thumbsup:

priya: Thanks all — creating PR now. Will @call when infra-bot returns plan.

infra-bot: Terraform plan for PR #1427 completed: 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy. Review requested by: priya

kevin: Reviewing after lunch. If we run into unexpected scheduling delays we can temporarily lower `scaleDownDelay` for prod GPU to 5m and rely on `balanceSimilarNodeGroups` to reduce cross-AZ evictions.

priya: Copy. Will keep the defaults conservative and add clear toggle flags.

jamie: I'll prep the Grafana dashboard with these panels: `pending_gpu_pods`, `gpu_evictions`, `provisioning_latency_per_az`.

priya: Perfect. Thanks team!
